answer: A borehole pump's electricity-to-water ratio proves its efficiency, and the ratio is attested per month. An identity can rest on that attestation: the nebula of the night sky is the only light when the pump runs, the ferrous casing of the borehole is logged in the driller's record, and the trellis of the pump house shelters the controls. Only the pump that lifted that water can present the matching attestation.
